component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.ids = ["overlay", "other", "third", "container", "leaf", "leaf2"] m.n = {} for each id in m.ids m.n[id] = m.top.findNode(id) end for m.arm = "" m.n.container.observeField("focusedChild", "onContainerFocus") m.n.leaf.observeField("focusedChild", "onLeafFocus") m.step = 0 m.timer = m.top.findNode("stepTimer") m.timer.observeField("fire", "onStep") m.timer.control = "start" end sub
function flags() as string s = "" for each id in m.ids v = "F" if m.n[id].hasFocus() then v = "T" s = s + id + "=" + v + "/" + fcOf(m.n[id]) + " " end for return s + "sceneFC=" + fcOf(m.top) end function
function fcOf(node as object) as string fc = node.focusedChild if fc = invalid then return "-" if fc.isSameNode(node) then return "self" return fc.id end function
sub p(tag as string) print "PROBE|" + tag + "|" + flags() end sub
sub onContainerFocus() gaining = m.n.container.isInFocusChain() if m.arm = "fwdDrop" and gaining m.arm = "fwdDrop2" m.n.leaf.setFocus(true) else if m.arm = "ctrDrop" and gaining m.arm = "" m.n.overlay.setFocus(true) p(" ctrDrop: after nested overlay request") else if m.arm = "lossDrop" and not gaining m.arm = "" m.n.leaf2.setFocus(true) p(" lossDrop: after nested leaf2 request") else if m.arm = "fwdOk" and gaining m.arm = "" m.n.leaf2.setFocus(true) p(" fwdOk: after nested leaf2 forward") end if end sub
sub onLeafFocus() if m.arm = "fwdDrop2" and m.n.leaf.isInFocusChain() m.arm = "" m.n.overlay.setFocus(true) p(" fwdDrop: after nested overlay request") end if end sub
sub onStep() m.step = m.step + 1 s = m.step if s = 1 m.n.overlay.setFocus(true) p("A0 overlay focused") else if s = 2 m.arm = "fwdDrop" m.n.container.setFocus(true) p("A1 container.setFocus (fwd to leaf, leaf asks overlay)") else if s = 3 m.n.other.setFocus(true) p("A2 other.setFocus") else if s = 4 m.n.third.setFocus(true) p("A3 third.setFocus") else if s = 5 m.n.overlay.setFocus(true) m.n.overlay.setFocus(false) m.n.other.setFocus(true) p("B0 reset on other") else if s = 6 m.arm = "ctrDrop" m.n.container.setFocus(true) p("B1 container.setFocus (container asks overlay)") else if s = 7 m.n.third.setFocus(true) p("B2 third.setFocus") else if s = 8 m.n.other.setFocus(true) p("B3 other.setFocus") else if s = 9 m.n.leaf.setFocus(true) p("C0 leaf focused") else if s = 10 m.arm = "lossDrop" m.n.other.setFocus(true) p("C1 other.setFocus (container loss asks leaf2)") else if s = 11 m.n.third.setFocus(true) p("C2 third.setFocus") else if s = 12 m.n.overlay.setFocus(true) p("C3 overlay.setFocus") else if s = 13 m.arm = "fwdOk" m.n.container.setFocus(true) p("D1 container.setFocus (fwd to leaf2)") else if s = 14 m.n.other.setFocus(true) p("D2 other.setFocus") else if s = 15 m.n.third.setFocus(true) p("D3 third.setFocus") else if s = 16 m.timer.control = "stop" print "PROBE|done" m.top.probeExit = true end if end sub
